authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/korg/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/korg/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a control change the document says the instrument recognises, or a row of its NRPN table, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

17 NRPN value(s) wider than 7 bits go as the document prints the format: the low bits first on their own controller, then the rest on CC 6. CEditor sends these; it does not yet put the two halves together when the instrument sends them.

MOD FX SUB TYPE (CC 96) depends on MOD FX TYPE, and MULTI SUB TYPE SELECT (CC 103) on MULTI TYPE, so both are numbers with their lists in the description. The document's transmitted values for the USER sub types end at 128, which is not a MIDI value.
CC 80 (SYNC) is a number: the document's receive and transmit tables disagree on its values (6-08, 2-08).
CC 81 (RING) is a number: the document's receive and transmit tables disagree on its values (6-09, 2-09).
Not a parameter here, Bank Select, part of preset recall: CC 0, 32.
Not a parameter here, Data Entry, part of the NRPN messages: CC 6.
Not a parameter here, the low bits of a value wider than 7 bits, sent before it: CC 63.
Not a parameter here, an NRPN or RPN selector, part of the NRPN messages: CC 98, 99.
Not a parameter here, a channel mode message: CC 120, 122, 123.

CC 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 24, 26, 27, 28, 29, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39, 40, 41, 43, 44, 54, 59, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110 take a 10-bit value when its low 3 bits come first on CC 63, as the document says; CEditor sends them as 7-bit controllers, 0 - 127, which the instrument also takes.
Left out, the program name, one character per NRPN; CEditor cannot edit text over NRPN yet: NRPN -- 01H, -- 02H, -- 03H, -- 04H, -- 05H, -- 06H, -- 07H, -- 08H, -- 09H, -- 0AH, -- 0BH, -- 0CH.
Left out, printed without a range: NRPN -- 48H (USER PARAM 1), -- 49H (USER PARAM 2), -- 4AH (USER PARAM 3), -- 4BH (USER PARAM 4), -- 4CH (USER PARAM 5), -- 4DH (USER PARAM 6).
The NRPN table prints the parameter MSB as "--"; CC 99 is sent as 0.
Mark *6-14 is read from the footnote printed as *5-14: printed between *6-13 and *6-15 as *5-14, a number the receive table uses for nothing else.

Pull: CURRENT PROGRAM DATA DUMP REQUEST, answered by the current program in Korg's 8-in-7 packing (384Bytes (7bit) -> 336Bytes (8bit)). 78 parameter(s) are read back from it by the program table's offsets; a controller parameter reads the top seven bits of its 10-bit field, the value its controller sends.
The program table marks two-byte values H and L without saying which is which; they are read low byte first, which the prologue document's own TEMPO (300~6000 as H:0~7 then L:0~4) settles.
The exclusive header carries the global MIDI channel as 3g; the profile's deviceId variable is that byte, 30H for channel 1.

In the program dump but not read back: PORTAMENTO (the dump holds 0 - 1 where the parameter is 0 - 127); VOICE MODE TYPE (the dump's list prints the value 2 twice); SYNC (the dump holds 0 - 1 where the parameter is 0 - 127); RING (the dump holds 0 - 1 where the parameter is 0 - 127); MULTI TYPE (the dump names a value "USER" the parameter has no choice for); PROGRAM LEVEL (the dump holds 0 - 132 where the parameter is 0 - 120); Program Transpose (the dump holds 0 - 25 where the parameter is 1 - 25).

Not found under its own name in the program dump, so not read back: Modulation1, Modulation2, VOICE MODE DEPTH, MULTI SHAPE, DAMPER, MOD FX SUB TYPE, MULTI SUB TYPE SELECT, MULTI SHIFT SHAPE, CV IN1, CV IN2, CV IN 1 ASSIGN, CV IN 1 RANGE, CV IN 2 ASSIGN, CV IN 2 RANGE, EG VELOCITY, MASTER VOLUME.
